given_when_then.given: A payment is processed between a customer and a store partner
given_when_then.when: The system generates a financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.

given_when_then.given: A delivery proof is missing for a completed order
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to archive the financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: the system must flag the record as incomplete and prevent final settlement until delivery proof is provided.

success_criteria: Financial transaction record includes item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
System links a financial transaction record to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
